dissent.en: Voting against the monetary policy action were Lisa D. Cook and Beth M. Hammack, who preferred to raise the target range for the federal funds rate by 1/4 percentage point at this meeting.

new.en: The Committee decided to maintain the target range for the federal funds rate at 3-3/4 to 4 percent, in support of the Federal Reserve's dual mandate.

old.en: The Committee decided to raise the target range for the federal funds rate by 1/4 percentage point to 3-3/4 to 4 percent, in support of the Federal Reserve's dual mandate.

new.en: The Committee is continuing its policy of maintaining ample reserves in the banking system.

old.en: The Committee is continuing its policy of maintaining ample reserves in the banking system.

new.en: Economic activity is expanding at a strong pace.

old.en: Economic activity is expanding at a solid pace.

new.en: While uncertainty remains elevated owing, in part, to geopolitical developments, domestic spending has been resilient.

old.en: While uncertainty remains elevated owing, in part, to geopolitical developments, domestic spending has been resilient.

new.en: Productivity growth is strong, and capital investment is robust.

old.en: Productivity growth is strong, and capital investment is robust.

new.en: Job gains have kept pace with the workforce, and the unemployment rate has changed little.

old.en: Job gains have kept pace with the workforce, and the unemployment rate has changed little.

new.en: The accumulation of more information will help the Committee determine the policy stance appropriate to ensure a timely return of inflation to the Committee's 2 percent goal.

old.en: Today's policy action will support a timelier return to the Committee's 2 percent goal.

new.en: The Committee will deliver price stability.

old.en: The Committee will deliver price stability.
